frontier.mechanism: Insn 115 (and $v0, $v0, 0xFFF finalizing ang_prev = call1_ret & 0xFFF) is hoisted by sched1 from RTL position (114,117) to (145,147) — one slot before call2. A pure-C form that forces the mask to be materialized earlier (at the call1 return) or defers it into the compare's use site could eliminate the hoist window.
